label: Плыть / Плавать
description: A 10-sentence card contrasting плыть (one trip, now) with плавать (habitual/round-trip and general ability).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: One trip now. Плыву is determinate, first-person of плыть. It names a single swimming act toward one goal, к берегу, the classic determinate trigger.
Strategic focus: General ability. Плавать is the indeterminate infinitive after умеет. Ability with no single direction always selects the indeterminate member of the pair.
Strategic focus: One trip now. Плывёт is determinate, third-person of плыть. The scene shows one directed approach unfolding now, к нам, so the determinate form fits.

missions.phrase: Каждое лето мы плаваем в озере.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Habitual activity. Плаваем is indeterminate, first-person plural of плавать. Каждое лето marks a repeated, multidirectional pastime, the core indeterminate trigger.
Strategic focus: Minimal pair, now. Плывёт is determinate; сейчас and the single line против течения pin one directed swim. Compare with плавать, which would mean swimming about generally.

missions.phrase: Эта рыба плавает у самого дна.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Minimal pair, habit. Плавает is indeterminate, third-person of плавать. It describes habitual, undirected movement around one area, the mirror of the determinate плывёт above.
Strategic focus: One past trip. Плыл is the determinate masculine past of плыть. It describes one directed swim on a specific occasion, вчера, so the determinate past is correct.

missions.phrase: В детстве я плавал каждый день.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past habit. Плавал is the indeterminate masculine past of плавать. Каждый день across childhood marks repeated, undirected sessions, which selects the indeterminate form.
Strategic focus: One trip now. Плывёт is determinate, third-person of плыть. The question куда asks about the single destination of a vessel sailing in progress, a determinate context.

missions.phrase: Дельфины часто плавают рядом с лодками.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Habitual activity. Плавают is indeterminate, third-person plural of плавать. Часто marks a repeated, multidirectional behaviour with no single goal, the indeterminate trigger.
